subject: Intro + intake: discovery & demo coordination for NexGenHealth
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@nexgenhealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + intake: discovery & demo coordination for NexGenHealth

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the quick response on the inbound form. Would love to get a 30–45m discovery call on the calendar so we can:
- Surface your primary latency/cost/throughput goals for inference
- Determine compliance/segmentation needs (VPC, SOC2 scope, data residency)
- Identify the internal champions we should include for a demo (eng, procurement, security)

We can have Soojin (solutions engineer) join to cover the technical architecture and Ben (customer success) on the follow-up. A few slots that work for us (PDT):
- Tue Aug 17, 10:00–10:45
- Tue Aug 17, 14:00–14:45
- Wed Aug 18, 09:00–09:45

If none of those fit, please propose 2 windows that work for your team and include the best contact for procurement and security so we can send any pre-read (SOC 2 summary, data handling overview).

Planning to send a short pre-demo questionnaire and a draft agenda once we lock time.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-capabilities-one-pager.pdf (1 page)

Aditya —

Appreciate the quick outreach. We should include our engineering lead (Mike Chan) and procurement in the initial call. Security is looped on the thread for the SOC2/architecture conversation.

Our availability (PT):
- Mon Aug 16, 11:00–11:45
- Tue Aug 17, 13:00–13:45

Prefer a single 45m session with a short demo + Q&A. Also: please send the SOC 2 summary and any high-level notes on data retention/telemetry in advance. Mike is primarily concerned about model artifact residency and KV cache behavior with PHI.

Thanks,
Alex Nguyen
Senior Product Manager, NexGenHealth
alex.nguyen@nexgenhealth.com | (206) 555-0944

To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@nexgenhealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + intake: discovery & demo coordination for NexGenHealth

Hi Alex / Aditya —

Thanks for looping me in. A couple of quick notes from the SE side to make the call productive:
- Target audience: please confirm if Mike will be hands-on (eng lead) or high-level PM. If hands-on, we can include a short live walk-through of model deployment and KV cache behavior.
- Pre-demo ask: sample request distribution (avg tokens per request, percent streaming vs. batch) and a sample anonymized prompt/response to understand shapes.
- Security: happy to run through SOC2 artifacts in 10–15m; if NexGen has a vendor questionnaire, please share and I’ll pull the relevant artifacts.

Proposed agenda (30–45m):
1) Intros + goals (5m)
2) Architecture and integration patterns (10–15m)
3) Short demo of routing/caching/fallbacks (10–15m)
4) Security/procurement questions + next steps (5–10m)

We can bring Ben for the post-call next steps and trial setup. I also attached a short discovery agenda that I use as a template.

Slots we can confirm quickly: Tue Aug 17, 13:00–13:45 PT (aligns with Alex’s preference) — tentative until Alex confirms.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Attachment: discovery-agenda.pdf (1 page)
From: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@nexgenhealth.com>

Quick update — apol, a conflict came up on Tue afternoon. Can we move to Wed Aug 18, 09:30–10:15 PT? That would give us a slightly longer session which is probably helpful.

If that works for you all, please send an updated invite. Mike and procurement are OK with that window.

Thanks —
Alex
